single_mentions.point: After a father died, the notes he had left in the app made settling his estate much easier for the family

reader_notes: Only 8 unfiltered Apple reviews, and only 1 is from someone acting for another person (a child settling a late father's estate, so after-death help rather than ongoing care). The 7 dropped reviews are people planning their own affairs; 5 of them complain that the iPad app is only a phone-size version while praising the website, and one long 5-star review (c-1) mentions a $99.99 yearly price, fast support and trust in data handling, but for the writer's own planning. No themes are possible from one item.
